To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the short circuit current of DFIG varies with the change in the wind speed.
the DFIG short-circuit current contribution is very high and the short circuit current is directly proportional to the wind speed.
the short circuit current of a wind farm is a function of the wind speed and the voltage drop of the generator.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the short circuit current calculation of a DFIG during symmetrical fault with different wind speeds and voltage drops.
the short circuit current calculation of DFIG under symmetrical faults with various wind speeds.
the short circuit current of DFIG and its behavior under various wind speeds.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the short circuit current calculation of DFIG is very much dependent on the wind speed at the time of short circuit fault occurrence and the voltage drop in the output terminals of the generator at the time of fault occurrence.
the short circuit current is dependent on the wind speed.
the short circuit current calculation is dependent on the wind speed, voltage drop and the type of the generator.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, short-circuit current contribution of DFG under symmetrical faults is dependent on the wind speed and voltage drops of the output of the generator.
the short circuit current of DFIG can be calculated by considering the voltage drops of the stator side, rotor side and the converter.
the short circuit current of a DFIG depends on the voltage drop at the generator terminal and the speed of the wind.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the short circuit current of DFIG depends on the wind speed.
the short-circuit current contribution of DFGI can be controlled by controlling the wind speed.

the short circuit current of DFIG can be calculated analytically by using a few equations and the results obtained from analytical method are in close proximity to that obtained from the simulation results.
